title: Secret and Significance of Akshaya Tritiya
description:
Every year, millions of Indians rush to buy gold on Akshaya Tritiya, believing it brings endless prosperity. But is this really tradition, or just a clever marketing gimmick by jewelry shops? In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts exposes how this so-called “auspicious day” became a business strategy rooted in superstition, how gold companies push people into debt, and why even supermarkets, banks, and astrologers jump on the bandwagon.

If you’ve searched for Akshaya Tritiya truth, gold buying superstition, Akshaya Tritiya debunked, why people buy gold, Akshaya Tritiya explained, Indian superstitions, marketing gimmicks in India, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations about science and skepticism.

#AkshayaTritiya #Superstition #GoldMyth #Pseudoscience #CriticalThinking
